title: Three-body-inspired bounded hyperchaotic map: reproduction code
description: Python code that reproduces the analyses, tables and figures of the article A Three-Body-Inspired Bounded Hyperchaotic Map: Mechanism, Scaling with the Number of Bodies, and Numerical Reliability: the vectorised map and its closed-form Jacobian, Lyapunov spectra, coupling controls, scaling with the number of bodies, two-parameter diagrams, basins of attraction, comparison with established maps, numerical-reliability checks (60-digit reference, NIST SP 800-22 multi-sequence protocol) and the generation of the LaTeX tables and number macros.
